scope: Prepared-save browser integration evidence only; fixtures provide starting inventory, research, and position. This is not normal-progression or mobile-device evidence.
environment: Headless Chromium / Linux / SwiftShader software WebGL
preparationPolicy: Direct runtime setup is limited to inventory, research, player position, natural world generation, and a one-time electrical test-energy escrow. The escrow remains unclaimed until storage is installed through the UI. All crafting, delivery, attunement, device installation/operation, machine assembly/charging/firing, attacking, and saving use visible UI or keyboard/pointer input.

actions.input: weapon shape/material selects and craft/equip buttons
inventory battery placement, explicit fixed-energy escrow transfer
machine name/grid/voxel/component selectors, install and fixed-store charge buttons
